title: Cpvp baloizya pack
description: best cpvp mods ;) to be HT1 with opti mods
body:
This modpack is designed for Crystal PvP on Minecraft 1.21.11. It includes optimization mods for higher FPS and PvP utility mods such as crystal and anchor improvements. All included mods are allowed on most servers. Recommended for players who want a smooth CPvP experience.
!!!Dont use it on minemen or flowpvp (if you want to play this server remove hero anchor and anchor opti)!!!
